_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_AddOutfitEmptyTip: Starts nude with every slot hidden, so you dress this one from nothing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_AddOutfitFromBaseTip: Starts with every piece this character is really wearing, so you can change one slot and keep the rest
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_AddOutfitTip: Makes a new outfit that leaves every slot to your base gear. Right click for one seeded from that gear, or a nude one with every slot hidden
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_AwayHint: %s is away. Showing the saved outfit (read only).
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyBareShowTip: Put the outfit back on. Nothing is saved or changed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyBareTip: See the body without gear. Nothing is saved or changed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyBusy: OBody is not ready yet. If it stays out, save and reload once.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyNoPresets: OBody has no presets for this character.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyORefitTip: ORefit reshapes your body to fit the armor you are really wearing, not the outfit you see. Default follows your OBody setting. Turn it off for an outfit that looks very different from your actual armor
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyPresetMissing: Saved preset is not installed. It has been kept, not cleared.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyPushUpTip: Adds lift on top of the body you already built. It cannot take away a push-up an armor was built with, and it only shows for bodies that carry the sliders for it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BodyWeightShared: This character shares an actor base with others of their kind, so a weight set here would reshape all of them permanently. Only unique characters can have their weight changed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Body_NoCardNoValues: No picture, because this preset carries no slider values, so there is no shape to build. An installed preset needs its BodySlide entry; a custom one carries its own set name
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Body_NoCardSetMissing: No picture, because this preset is built from the slider set "%s" and that set is not installed. The preset is here and the body it shapes is not. Install its BodySlide files and the card will draw
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Body_NoCardSetUnusable: No picture, because the slider set "%s" is installed but its morph data could not be read. The log names the file and what was wrong with it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_BrowsePresets: Browse preset looks shipped by armor mods.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ClearDefaultBodyTip: This is this character's usual body. Clearing it puts them back on the body they had before Fitting Room touched them
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ClearDefaultHairColourTip: They go back to their own hair colour on any outfit that does not pick one
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ClearDefaultLookTip: This is this character's default. Clearing it puts them back on their own look when an outfit names nothing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ClickPreset: Click a preset to try it on.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CloseUnaffordable: You have changes you cannot pay for yet, so Apply will not take them. Closing puts your character back the way you found them and the work is gone.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CloseUnsaved: You have changes you have not applied yet. Closing puts your character back the way you found them, so press Apply first if you want to keep them.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CollectedTip: Only looks from gear you have owned at some point
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ControllerHints: Controller:  [R-stick] Turn and zoom   [LB/RB] Outfit   [LT/RT] Page   [Y] Clear the slot under the pointer   [B] Close   |   Use the mouse to choose things
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CopyOutfitTip: Make a second outfit just like this one, including its colours, and switch to it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CostTip: Cost to apply: %llu gold (%u changed slot%s)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_CuratedTip: Preset looks shipped by armor mods (authored showcases)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DefaultWrongRace: Their usual choice here is not offered to this race, so they wear their own. It is kept, and comes back if they change back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DefaultWrongSex: Their usual choice here is not offered to this sex, so they wear their own. It is kept, and comes back if they change back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DiscoveredTip: Outfit sets auto-detected from your installed armor mods
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_Character: This piece carries your character's own colouring.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_EyeNeedsIris: This colours the far half of the eye and needs an iris colour on the near half. Set the iris first
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_EyeScleraBusy: The second colour is using the slot the white would need. Clear it and the white can take a colour again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_Glow: This piece glows, and dyeing it would spread the glow.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_Hair: This piece is hair. Dyeing it would streak along the strands.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_HairOwnColour: Your hair colour paints this piece. Set it on the Hair tile above
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_Torch: Your off hand is holding a torch, which shares this slot with the shield. A torch cannot be dyed.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_DyeSkip_Unsupported: This piece uses a material that cannot be dyed yet.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_AllPiecesTip: Puts this colour on every piece of armour and every weapon you have on. Hair and eyes are left alone, and one undo step covers the lot. With the metal rail on it leaves reflective pieces as they are
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_AppliedNone: On this piece: a colour of your own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendColourTip: Repaints the hue and keeps the piece's brightness exactly, so the shading survives a strong colour
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendDefaultTip: Uses the answer in Fitting Room's options, which is what every dye did before this row existed. On an eye that is the gentle recolour measured on real eyes
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendEyeNote: Reaches the iris and the white only
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendLuminosityTip: Gives every part of the piece the same brightness, so the shading goes flat. A curiosity rather than a dye
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendMultiplyTip: Darkens, and unlike soft light it does reach the white parts. It cannot lift a black, so a dark piece stays dark
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendOverlayTip: Soft light with the contrast pushed. Louder on the same colour
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendRecolourTip: Repaints the eye in the colour you pick, highlights and all. It takes the hue exactly, where the others keep some of the eye's own, and it does not hold the eye's original brightness, so a dark eye goes darker
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendScreenTip: Lightens, and it does reach the black parts. It cannot darken, so a pale piece stays pale
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendSoftLightTip: Tints gently and keeps every fold and scuff. It can never move a texture's pure blacks or pure whites, whichever colour you pick
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_BlendTip: How this colour is combined with what sits underneath it. From settings uses the answer in Fitting Room's options, which is what every dye did before this row existed. Soft light tints gently and keeps every fold and scuff, but it can never move a texture's pure blacks or pure whites. Multiply darkens and does reach the white parts. Screen lightens and does reach the black parts. Overlay is soft light with the contrast pushed. Colour repaints the hue and keeps the brightness exactly. Luminosity flattens the shading, which is a curiosity rather than a dye. On an eye this reaches the iris and the white only, and the glow and the reflection keep their own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ClearAllTip: Remove every colour from this whole outfit. One undo puts it all back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ColourTip: Type a hex code, or click the swatch for the full picker with hue and saturation
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_CopyTip: Copy this slot's colours, ready to paste onto another slot. Middle clicking a colour swatch copies that one instead
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_CutTip: Where metal begins on this piece. Lower it if the metal shows patches of the cloth colour, raise it if the cloth catches the metal's
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_EmptyNothingDyeable: Nothing you are wearing can be dyed.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_EmptyNothingWorn: You are not wearing anything to dye.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_EyeSecondTip: A second colour for the eye, taking the far half of the eye texture. On most eyes that gives each iris two tones. On eye meshes built with a separate half per eye it gives one colour per eye instead. Which one you get is decided by the eyes you are wearing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_EyesTip: Tint this outfit's eyes. An eye that glows is tinted through its glow so the colour stays inside the iris, and an ordinary eye has its texture recoloured. Clear it to hand their own eyes back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_FlakeTip: How strongly the reflection breaks into glinting speckles
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_GlossClearTip: The dye stops setting gloss, so the piece keeps its own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_GlossTip: Above the middle the highlight tightens toward metal, below it broadens and dulls. The middle leaves the piece as its author made it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_HairTip: Tint this outfit's hair. Your hair is tinted to the exact colour you pick, and if something rebuilds the head from scratch it falls back to the nearest colour your game provides
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_LockedFrozen: Locked. Your unlock rules did not all load, so nothing can be earned this session and there is no requirement to show. See FittingRoom.log
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_LockedNoRule: Locked. Reloading your save should unlock it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_LockedUnreadable: Locked, because the rule behind it could not be read. Nothing you do in game will unlock it. Fix or remove the file in Data/SKSE/Plugins/FittingRoom/Unlocks and reload
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ModeTip: How the two colours behave. Flat wears the first alone. Nacre sweeps between them with the light. Iridescent points the sweep at the reflection, where the piece has one. Metal dyes only the reflective parts and Cloth only the rest, each with the first colour. Two-tone gives the cloth the first colour and the metal the second
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_NeutralTip: 128/128/128 is the neutral and leaves the colour as it is. Black is not: it darkens the whole piece
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_NoGeometry: Nothing is showing in this slot to dye.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_NoSelection: Pick a swatch above, then choose a colour.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_Orphaned: This piece is no longer part of the item. You can still clear its colour.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_PaletteEmpty: No dyes are installed. Fitting Room ships a set in Data/SKSE/Plugins/FittingRoom/Dyes.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_PasteTip: Paste the copied colour onto the selected stripe. Middle clicking a stripe on the piece drops it there instead
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_PickPieceFirst: Pick a piece above, then choose a colour.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_PickSlotFirst: Select an armour slot to dye.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_RecentEmpty: Colours you mix yourself appear here.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ResetChannelTip: Remove the colour from this piece. Right clicking the swatch does the same
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ResetPieceTip: Remove every colour from this item
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SaveAsDyeTip: Keep this colour and finish as a dye of your own. It joins the palette under My Dyes and is still there after you quit
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SchemeApplyTip: Put this scheme's colours on the slot. They land in piece order, the same way a paste does
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SchemeDeleteTip: Delete this saved scheme. The outfits you already used it on keep their colours
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SchemeSaveTip: Save this slot's colours under a name, ready to use on any outfit or character
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_ScleraTip: Tint the whites of this outfit's eyes. It works on an eye whose textures mark out the iris, so the white can be told apart; a glowing eye keeps its own. Clear it to hand theirs back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SheenClearTip: The dye stops setting sheen, so the piece keeps its own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_SheenTip: The colour the highlight shines with
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_Stop2ClearTip: Back to one colour. The second stop is removed, not painted black
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_Stop2Tip: The second colour of a pearl. Type a hex or pick one
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_StoredClearable: A dye is still stored on this slot. Untick it to remove it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_StrengthTip: How much of the colour lands. 100% is the colour you picked, and anything lower leaves more of the material the way its author painted it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Dye_WholePieceTip: Puts this colour on every part of the piece you have selected. One undo covers the lot. With the metal rail on it leaves reflective parts as they are
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_EditingTip: Choose who to dress: yourself or a follower
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ExportTip: Write this outfit as a shareable preset file\n(SKSE/Plugins/FittingRoom/Exports)\nAn export is a file on disk, so it is the way to carry an outfit to another character
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ExportedNote: Outfit exported. It is on the Outfit presets page, under Exported, and Save there puts it into any character's outfits.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ExportedTip: Outfits you exported yourself, ready to save into any character's library
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_FavoritesTip: Only looks you have starred (click the star on a row)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_GridViewTip: Show every item as a picture card rendered from its real model. Cards fill in one per frame, and once rendered they are kept on disk, so the next visit does not redraw them
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairClearTip: Clear the staged hair style. Their own hair shows again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairSourceTip: Show hair from one plugin only
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairStyleResetTip: Put back the hairstyle you had before Fitting Room changed it (%s)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairStyleSmpFailed: Hair physics failed to start for this style, so Fitting Room took it back off. That can be a one-off, so the block only lasts this session. Restart the game and it is tried again.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairStyleSmpUnavailable: This style needs hair physics and no supported HDT-SMP build is running, so the engine would stretch its strands onto a follower's head. Install a supported Faster HDT-SMP build and the style comes back on its own. On your own character it still works.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairStyleTooManyBones: Skyrim cannot bind this style's mesh onto a follower's head. Some styles carry more bones than the engine can attach, physics hair especially. Others are exported in a way that only survives a full head rebuild. On your own character it still works.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HairTip: Auto follows whatever your outfit covers. Show keeps hair visible under a helmet; Hide removes it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HeadExtraRowTip: Right click to take it off. Right click again to put their own back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HeadPartClearTip: Clear the staged choice. Their own look shows again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HideAllTip: Hide every slot, so you wear nothing visible
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_HideUnfitTip: Hide styles that don't fit your body (the red rows). Uncheck to show them again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_IconOpensTip: Click to open it on the right
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_LeaveUnsaved: You have changes here you have not saved. Leaving puts your character back the way you found them.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_LockWindowTip: Keep the editor at a fixed width. Uncheck to drag its right edge and set how wide it sits
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_ApplyTip: Apply the checked parts to the player. The editor closes so you can see the result
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_BlockAbsentTip: This look did not capture that part
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_DeleteConfirmFace: Delete the look '%s'? Its saved face preset goes with it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_DeleteFaceTip: Deleting this look also removes its saved face preset
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_DroppedTip: %d part(s) of this look could not be read and will not apply
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_Empty2: Name the character above and press Save look.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_ExportHeadTip: Write the current head as a RaceMenu external character. The log says when it lands
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_ExportPendingTip: The last export has not finished yet
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_FaceOffTip: RaceMenu is not installed, so the saved face cannot be applied
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_FaceSavingTip: The face is still saving. It finishes when you close the editor; changing saves before then loses it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_LookFaceUnknown: Its RaceMenu preset could not be read, so the face may need mods this list does not name
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_NameTaken: Another look already uses that name.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_OverwriteConfirm: A look named '%s' already exists. Overwrite it with the character as they stand?
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PartsAllTip: Tick every part this look carries
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PickPrompt: Pick a look on the left.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PlayerOnly: Looks always capture and apply the player, whoever you have selected for editing.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetBinary: Older binary format. RaceMenu still reads it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetLoadTip: Apply this preset to the player, sculpt included. The editor closes so you can see the result
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetNameTakenTip: A look with this name already exists
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetNeedsUnknown: Could not read what this one needs
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetNoMesh: No head mesh saved beside it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetNoTint: No face tint saved beside it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetPickPrompt: Pick a preset on the left.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetSaveAsLookTip: Save your current gear, dyes and body as a look whose face is this preset
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetSearch: Search the RaceMenu presets by name
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_PresetUnreadable: The file is not where the list said it was
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_Rejected: %d look file(s) could not be read; the log names them.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_ReplaceTip: Also removes the overlays, shape and skin this look leaves out, so nothing carries over from the last character
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_SavePendingTip: Still writing the last look; one moment
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_SaveTip: Capture the character as they stand: face, outfit, dyes, makeup, body, skin and overlays
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_Search: Search your saved looks by name
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Looks_TakePortraitTip: Photograph the framed head for this card. Zoom the camera onto the face first for a tighter shot
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_AtCeiling: All 15 makeup layers are in use. Turn one off to wear another.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_AtCeilingPick: This layer cannot be turned on until you turn another one off.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_FaceNote: Your character's own features. They take a colour, and your race decides the shape
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_FaceSlotNote: Your race decides the mask this slot paints through, so it takes a colour and not a texture.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_NotBuilt: This character has not been through the character editor yet, so the game has not made their makeup layers. Open RaceMenu once and they appear here.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_OffsetXTip: Slide the art sideways across the face texture. Which way that runs on the face depends on how the head's texture is laid out
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_OverCeiling: This character wears more makeup layers than the game can composite. Makeup edits are held back until you turn some off, because going past the limit crashes the game.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_PlayerOnly: Makeup is stored on the player's own tint layers, so only the player can be edited here. A follower keeps theirs on their character record, which other actors can share.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_PositionResetTip: Put the art back where its author drew it. The baked texture stays on disk and is reused if you move it there again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_PositionTip: Slide, resize or turn this layer's art on the face. It lands when you let go of the slider rather than while you drag, because the game rebuilds the whole face texture to composite these layers and following the cursor would cost that rebuild every frame
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_ResetTip: Puts this slot back to the colour and mask your race gives it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_RevertTip: Puts every makeup layer back to how it was when you opened this page
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_RightClear: Right click to take it off
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Mk_StrengthTip: How strongly this layer is painted on, and zero takes it off
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_NoDiscovered: No outfit mods detected on this character yet.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_NoFitting: No fitting styles for this slot.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_ClearAllTip: Empties every layer on this character, on all four locations
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_Disabled: Overlays are switched off in skee64.ini. Set bEnableOverlays to 1 and restart to use this page.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_FinishGlossTip: How tight the highlight on this layer is. Low reads as matte cloth or chalk, high as wet skin, lacquer or polished metal. It changes the shine on the layer alone and never on the skin under it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_FinishResetTip: Hand the layer's finish back to the body underneath. Fitting Room stops setting it at all rather than putting a number of its own there, so the layer shines exactly as much as the skin it sits on
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_FinishSpecularTip: How bright that highlight burns. Gloss decides how sharp the shine is and this decides how much of it there is, so a wet look wants both up
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_GlowStrengthTip: How brightly the layer gives off its glow colour. Zero is off, which is what keeps a layer dark when you have coloured it black. Art that is meant to glow needs this turned up
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_KeepOffset: Keep the position when I switch art
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_KeepOffsetTip: Picking different art for this layer normally puts the sliders back where the new art was drawn. Tick this and the position, size and turn stay as you set them, and the new art is redrawn at those numbers straight away
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_MaskTip: The stencil copy of another design. It is black everywhere the art is not, so wearing it paints that whole area black
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_Missing: RaceMenu answered but handed over no overlay system. Another mod is usually shipping an older skee64.dll that has won the overwrite.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_NoMatch: Nothing here matches what you typed.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_NoRaceMenu: RaceMenu is not loaded, and overlays are RaceMenu's.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_NoTextures: No overlay textures found. They install under Data\textures\actors\character\overlays, and packs that keep theirs inside a BSA cannot be listed here.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_OffsetXTip: Slide the art sideways across its texture. Which way that runs on the body depends on how the body's texture is laid out
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_OffsetYTip: Slide the art up or down its texture
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_PickLayer: Pick a layer on the left to give it a texture.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_PickLayer2: What you can paint onto it appears here.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_PositionResetTip: Put the art back where its author drew it. The baked texture stays on disk and is reused if you move it there again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_PositionTip: Slide, resize or turn this overlay on the skin. While you drag, the change shows at once. When you let go, the art is redrawn into a texture under textures\FittingRoom\baked and RaceMenu keeps that texture the way it keeps any other, across re-equips and saves
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_ReadRaceMenuTip: Opens RaceMenu so Fitting Room can read the overlay lists your packs registered on this install. What it finds there wins over the list that ships with the mod, and the editor closes while you are in there
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_Redo: Put back the change you just undid
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_RightClear: Right-click a layer to empty it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_RotationTip: Turn the art about its own centre, in degrees
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_ScaleTip: Grow or shrink the art about its own centre. Below 1 leaves bare skin around it, above 1 can push its edges off the texture
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_StoreLost: Your body is still wearing overlay art, but RaceMenu's preset load cleared its record of it, so the rows below read empty and cannot be edited. Apply the look again to put the record back.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_TooOld: The skee64.dll that loaded is older than this page was built for, so nothing here would reach your character. On Skyrim Special Edition this is expected and there is nothing to fix: RaceMenu's last SE build is 0.4.16 from 2020 and these interfaces have moved on since, so this part of Fitting Room needs Anniversary Edition. On AE it means another mod is bundling an older skee64.dll over RaceMenu's own.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_Undo: Undo the last change to this character's layers
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Ovl_UnsortedTip: These packs never said where their art belongs, so it shows up everywhere
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Pane_StylesTip: Browse and assign styles for the selected slot
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_PresetPartial: You have collected %d of %d pieces. Discover the entire set to save it. (%s)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_PreviewOnHoverTip: Preview a style just by resting the mouse on its row
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_BodiesTip: Bodies. Build and edit body presets you can put on any character
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_BodiesTipOff: Bodies. Editing body presets is off in this development build
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_DyeTip: Dye. Colour the pieces of this outfit
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_LooksTip: Looks. Save the whole character as one look and bring it back later
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_OverlaysTip: Overlays. Layer tattoos, war paint and makeup onto this character
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_PresetsTip: Outfit presets. Browse discovered, curated, and exported outfits
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_RulesTipNpc: Rules apply to you, not to your followers. Switch back to yourself to edit them
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_RulesTipOff: Rules. Conditions that pick an outfit for you. Currently off, turn it back on inside
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_RulesTipOn: Rules. Conditions that pick an outfit for you. Currently on
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_RulesTipPaused: Rules. Conditions that pick an outfit for you. Currently paused because you picked a look by hand. Resume inside
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_SettingsTip: Settings. UI size and editor options
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Rail_StylesTip: Outfits. Build and switch the looks you have saved
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_RandomTip: Pick a random fitting style for the selected slot
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Random_None: Nothing to pick from with the current filters.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_RemoveAssignmentTip: Clear this follower's saved outfit assignment
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_RescanCuratedTip: Re-read the Presets folder. Authors: drop a file in, click, see it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_RescanDiscoveredTip: Re-scan your armor mods for outfit sets
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ResetOutfitTip: Reset every slot to your base gear (unhides everything)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ResetWindowTip: Snap the editor back to its default position and size
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_RowPreviewOnlyTip: Nothing you are wearing sits under this piece, so it shows in the fitting room only. Outside, the lore rule hides it. Equip gear on a slot this piece covers, or turn off "Transmog needs real gear underneath" in Settings
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SelectPreset: Select a preset to try it on.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultBodyNoneTip: Pick a body from the list first. A default has to name something
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultBodyTip: Wear this body whenever the outfit you have on does not name one of its own. It belongs to this character in this save, and a different save has its own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultHairColourNoneTip: Pick a hair colour first, then this makes it their usual
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultHairColourTip: Make this their usual hair colour, on every outfit that does not pick one of its own. The outfit gives up its copy and they keep the colour
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultLookNoneTip: Pick one from the list first. A default has to name something
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SetDefaultLookTip: Wear this whenever the outfit you have on does not name one of its own. It belongs to this character in this save, and a different save has its own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_BodyFitFilterTip: Body lists show only presets built for the body this character wears. Turn it off to see every preset you have installed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_BounceNoCbpc: CBPC is not installed, so there is nothing to hand the bounce to.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_BouncePercentTip: Skyrim reads breast bounce from the armour you really wear, not the one on screen. Turn this up to let the outfit decide instead
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_CameraFocusSlot: Move the camera to the part you are editing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_CameraFocusSlotTip: Swings the camera onto whatever the editor is working on: your head while you pick a helmet, your feet while you pick boots. You can still orbit and zoom by hand, and what you zoom to is kept. Needs Menu Studio, with its own camera switched on there
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_CardSizeTip: How big the picture cards draw, in steps of the editor's font size. Pictures already rendered stay valid at any size
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_ChargeGoldTip: Each changed slot costs gold when you apply an outfit
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_CollectionSharedTip: On: any piece one of your characters has owned is offered to all of them, through a file beside the INI. Off: each character finds their own. Which pieces a character has SEEN is never shared, so inherited gear still arrives marked as newly found. Nothing takes a look back out of the file, so switching this off later leaves what is already in it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DirectEntryTip: Opens Fitting Room from anywhere, with no menu needed first. Unassigned until you bind it here. Closing again puts you back where you were
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DirectEntryUnavailable: This FLICK is too old to bind a key here. Update FLICK, or use the Fitting Room hotkey above from your inventory
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeBlendTip: How a colour is combined with the fabric underneath it. Soft light is the original and the safe answer: it tints gently and keeps every fold and scuff, but it can never shift a texture's pure blacks or pure whites, whichever colour you pick. Multiply darkens and does reach the white parts. Screen lightens and does reach the black parts. Overlay is soft light with the contrast pushed. Colour repaints the fabric's hue and keeps its brightness exactly. Luminosity is a curiosity rather than a dye, giving every part of a piece the same brightness so the shading goes flat. Armour only, and your eye colour is left alone
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeCardsPreviewTip: Queue a few sample cards using real colours from your palette, so you can see where they sit and how long they stay. They appear once you close this panel and are looking at the world again. Nothing is earned or changed by pressing this
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeCardsTip: On: a card appears at the top right the moment you earn a colour, with its swatch and its name. Off: colours are still earned and still marked with a gold corner in the dye grid, you are just not told at the time. Cards never show while this editor is open, because the gold corner already says so
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeKeepShineTip: On, a dyed piece keeps the reflection its mesh came with and that reflection takes the dye too, because the colour is painted into the textures instead of swapping the material. Off is cheaper and leaves reflective armour matte. Keeping the shine holds recoloured textures in video memory, and iDyeTextureBudgetMiB caps how much
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeReflectiveTip: Clicking a metal piece's own swatch always dyes it, whatever this is set to. This governs the bulk actions only. On: pasting a set or applying a scheme colours metal as well. Off: they leave metal alone, so one click cannot change everything you are wearing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeSortHueTip: On by default. Orders the swatches inside each group around the colour wheel, with the greys, blacks and whites gathered at the end. Off puts each pack back in the order its author wrote it. The groups themselves do not move either way
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeUnlocksSharedTip: On: colours earned by any of your characters are offered to all of them, through a file beside the INI. Off: each character earns its own. Your Seamstone charge and your progress counters are never shared and stay in the save that paid for them. Nothing takes a colour back out of the file, so switching this off later leaves what is already in it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_DyeUnlocksTip: On: a dye has to be earned by what your character has done before you can pick it, and a locked swatch says what it takes. Off: every dye is pickable. Either way you keep earning them in the background, and a dye already on a garment keeps showing
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_EditOtherNpcsTip: Lists everyone loaded around you in the Editing dropdown, not only your followers. Takes effect the next time Fitting Room opens
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_EyeAdvancedTip: Off: an eye takes two colours, one for the iris and one for the white. On: a third swatch appears that colours the far half of the eye texture. On most eyes that reads as two tones in each iris. On eye meshes built with a separate half per eye it reads as one colour per eye. It needs an iris colour to sit beside, and it takes the slot the white would use, so the white cannot be coloured while it is set. Turning this off keeps any colour already stored
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_ForgetSharedConfirmTip: Deletes both shared files now. Your characters keep their own colours and their own gear
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_ForgetSharedTip: Empty the two files that carry earned colours and found gear between your characters. Every character keeps what is in their own save. What goes is the head start a NEW character would have had. There is no undo, so this asks twice
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_FrameStyleTip: Fitting Room draws its own corners. Carved is ours, plain follows your theme
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_GridInventoryHideTip: Grid Inventory stops drawing while the editor is open but still takes the mouse, so its old area swallows a click and drag. This asks it to hide properly. Some builds answer by closing, which takes the editor with it: turn this off if that happens
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_HotkeyTip: Opens the editor in the inventory or while Screen Archer Menu is open
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_HoverPreviewCardsTip: Rest the pointer on a picture card and the character wears it for as long as you stay. Off by default, because the card already shows the item and a grid puts far more of them under the pointer than a list does
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_NextOutfitTip: Switches to your next saved outfit without opening the editor. Unbound by default
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_OutfitsSharedTip: A new character starts with the outfits you have already built instead of an empty list. Off by default, so outfits belong to the character who made them. Characters you have already played keep their own either way
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_OverlayShowAllTip: Off, the Overlays picker shows the art each pack meant for the part of the body you are painting, and leaves out the mask copies that draw as a black square. On, it shows everything you have installed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PagesHelp: Choose which pages appear in the sidebar down the left. Hiding one does not undo anything it wrote, and you can switch it back on here at any time.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PagesTip: A page can also be missing because it needs a mod you do not have. Hover its tile in the sidebar and it will say which
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PlaystyleFreeTip: Your hotkey opens the Fitting Room and changing an outfit is free. The same starting settings as the installer's Freeform choice
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PlaystyleLoreTip: Carry the Seamstone to open the Fitting Room, and spend its charge for each slot you change. Filled soul gems refill it, the same way you recharge an enchanted weapon. The same starting settings as the installer's Lore friendly choice
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PlaystyleNoStone: FittingRoomLore.esp is not installed, so there is no Seamstone to carry or to pay with. Lore friendly charges the same per slot in gold instead, and the Seamstone requirement stays switched on but does nothing. Reinstall the mod to add the plugin; it is a light plugin and costs you no load order slot.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_PlaystyleNote: Presets just change the settings below. Adjust anything, any time.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_RebuildPreviewsTip: Throw away every cached thumbnail and render them again as they are browsed. Use it after replacing a broken mesh, since a model that failed once is remembered and never retried on its own
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_RequireSeamstone: Require the Seamstone to open the editor
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_RequireSeamstoneTip: The Seamstone requirement only applies with the lore ESP (FittingRoomLore.esp)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_SaveNote: Changes save to FittingRoom.ini and apply next time you open the editor.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_SeamstoneMissing: Needs the Seamstone plugin (FittingRoomLore.esp), which is not installed, so this does nothing right now.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_SfwBodyCardsTip: On: a body preview card is built from that body mod's own covered slider set, the nevernude build it already ships, so the card shows the same shape wearing underwear. Works for 3BA, CBBE and HIMBO. UBE ships no covered build, so UBE presets are drawn unchanged
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_SharedNote: The two buttons above do not change these. They are not part of a playstyle, and they stay as you set them whichever preset you pick
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_TutorialReplayTip: Show the tutorial cards again, and turn them back on if you said no. Each page offers its own the next time you open it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Set_TutorialsOnTip: Off means no tutorial cards at all, including any added later. Answering no on the first card turns this off
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_ConfirmDeleteTip: Click again to delete it. There is no undo
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_CreateTip: Save these body sliders as a shape you can wear again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_DeletePrompt: Delete this shape? The file goes with it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_DiscardTip: Put this character back the way you found them
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_Export: Send to BodySlide's presets, where Screen Archer Menu and OBody can read it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_ExportNote: Exported shapes go to BodySlide's SliderPresets, under a Fitting Room folder.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_Intro: These sliders belong to the character. They stay the same whatever this character wears.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_MorphsMissing: RaceMenu is loaded, but it offered no body morph interface, so there is nothing for these sliders to write to.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_MorphsOld: RaceMenu is loaded, but the skee64.dll being used is older than Fitting Room needs. On Skyrim Special Edition this is expected and there is nothing to fix: RaceMenu's last SE build is 0.4.16 from 2020 and these interfaces have moved on since, so this part of Fitting Room needs Anniversary Edition. On AE it means another mod is bundling an older skee64.dll over RaceMenu's own.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_NameTip: Name this set of body sliders
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_NoRaceMenu: RaceMenu is not loaded, and Shape has nothing to write to without it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_NoSliders: No body sliders found. BodySlide has to be installed, and your body has to be built with morphs.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_SaveEmptyTip: Move a body slider first, then save it as a shape
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_SliderTip: Right-click a slider to put it back
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_TransformsMissing: RaceMenu answered but handed over no node transform system. Another mod is usually shipping an older skee64.dll that has won the overwrite.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_TransformsOld: RaceMenu is loaded, but its node transform interface is older than Fitting Room needs, so Shape has nothing it can safely write to. On Skyrim Special Edition this is expected and there is nothing to fix: RaceMenu's last SE build is 0.4.16 from 2020 and these interfaces have moved on since, so this part of Fitting Room needs Anniversary Edition. On AE it means another mod is bundling an older skee64.dll over RaceMenu's own. FittingRoom.log names the version it found and the one it wanted.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_Unexport: Take it back out of BodySlide's presets
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Shape_Unfiltered: Showing every slider your installed bodies describe. Some may not belong to the body you built, and those do nothing when you drag them.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_ShowAllTip: Show every slot again (clear to base gear)
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_DefaultNote: This character wears the base skin their load order gives them. Nothing has been changed
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_DefaultTip: The skin your load order gives this character, named after the mod it comes from where that can be told. Click to take any pack back off
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_HowTo: To add a pack, make a folder under Data\textures\FittingRoom\skins named after the skin and copy the mod's textures\actors\character files into it, femalebody_1.dds and the rest, keeping their names. Files are matched to the body by name, so a pack made for another body mesh only replaces the names it has in common
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_MissingTip: This character wears a skin pack that is not in your skins folder. Pick another card to replace it, or the Base Skin card to take it off
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_NoPacks: No skin packs found. Make a folder under Data\textures\FittingRoom\skins named after the skin and copy a skin mod's textures\actors\character files into it. Rescan happens the next time this page opens
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_NoRaceMenu: RaceMenu is not loaded, so there is nothing to change the skin through
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_OldRaceMenu: The RaceMenu on this load order does not offer what the skin changer needs. On Skyrim Special Edition this is expected and there is nothing to fix: RaceMenu's last SE build is 0.4.16 from 2020 and these interfaces have moved on since, so this part of Fitting Room needs Anniversary Edition. On AE it means another mod is bundling an older skee64.dll over RaceMenu's own.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_PackNote: Worn on the body, hands, feet and head. Skin tone and makeup stay, since the face system paints those over the texture
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_PackTip: Wear this pack. It swaps the body, hands, feet and head textures whose file names it carries, and the rest keep the game's own. Skin tone and makeup stay, since the face system paints those over the texture
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_PartialTip: Fitting Room added files to this pack after the game started, so wearing it now leaves part of it out, usually the face. Restart to get the rest
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RightBase: Right click to go back to the Base Skin
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RivalFailed: That skin could not be linked. The Fitting Room log says why. The usual cause is the skin mod sitting on a different drive from your mods folder.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RivalLinkedTip: Linked. Restart the game to wear it
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RivalTip: Could not link this skin. Click to try again
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RivalsMO2: Finding overridden skins needs Mod Organizer. This load order does not use one, so Fitting Room cannot tell what is installed behind the skin you can see.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RivalsOwnFile: The body still wears a file Fitting Room put there, so it cannot tell which skins are installed behind it. The Fitting Room log names the file.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_RowTip: The skin this character wears. Click to choose from the cards on the right
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Skin_SectionTip: The skin texture under every overlay. Each card on the right is a folder under textures\FittingRoom\skins, drawn on your own character. Packs made for another body are left out until you turn on Show every overlay texture
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SlotCoveredTip: Your %s slot (slot %u) is covered by %s, so it has no controls of its own. Clear that piece on its own row to free this slot
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_SwitchUnsaved: You have changes you have not applied yet. Switching outfit drops them and puts your character back the way you found them.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Target_AwayTip: This follower is not loaded right now, so their outfit cannot be edited. Travel to them and reopen the editor. Their saved assignment is kept and applies again the next time they load
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Target_NoneExampleTip: Anyone travelling with you appears in this list, and you can dress them the same way you dress yourself
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Target_TooFarTip: Greyed out followers cannot be edited: they are too far away, or standing on a different floor. Get closer to them, then reopen the editor
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_TryingOnBare: Trying on '%s'. Nothing is worn under %u of its %u pieces, so outside the fitting room the lore rule hides them
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Body1: Pick a preset on the left before anything appears on the right.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Body1Do: Pick a preset on the left. Nothing appears on the right until you do.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Body2: Edit values chooses which BodySlide endpoint each slider writes to. The weight slider says where between them this character sits.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Body3: The bar along the bottom is where you commit: undo, discard, save, export, and set as default.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Closing1: That is the tour. The gear at the bottom of the sidebar opens the settings: what an outfit costs, whether dyes have to be earned, and much else.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Closing2: Thanks for trying Fitting Room. If you get some use out of it, an endorsement on the mod page is much appreciated.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye1: The tiles on the left are the pieces you are wearing. The colours on the right are what you paint them with.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye2: Click a stripe on a tile first. It becomes the selected one, and the next colour you pick lands on it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye2Do: Click a stripe on a tile. The next colour you pick goes on it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye3: Right click a stripe to clear it. The Selection block above the colours is where you type a colour, copy one, or reset a piece.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye3Do: Now click a colour on the right. It lands on the stripe you selected.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Dye4: Right click a stripe to clear it. The Selection block above the colours is where you type a colour, copy one, or reset a piece.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Looks1: A look is your whole character in one file: face, body, skin, outfit, dyes and makeup. Any you save are listed on the left.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Looks2Do: Click one. Nothing moves yet, you are just seeing what is in it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Looks3: Only the ticked parts come back. Take a face and keep what you are wearing, or take the outfit and dyes and keep your own face. Greyed out means this look never saved that part.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Looks4: Looks are always your own character, never a follower. Type a name, press Save look, and it keeps you exactly as you are now. Your RaceMenu presets are on the other tab.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Outfits1: The tabs along the top are your saved outfits, and the + at the end makes a new one. Base gear is not an outfit. It is what this character is really wearing, and you cannot edit it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Outfits2Do: Click a row to pick that slot. Right click hides it.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Outfits3Do: Followers too. Click the name at the top to see who else is here.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Outfits4: Whether you press Apply depends on your settings. When an outfit costs you nothing, the editor saves as you go and the button says so. Outfits belong to this save, so export one if you want it on another character.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Ovl1: Overlays are art painted on the skin: tattoos, scars, warpaint, dirt. Each section on the left is one part of the body, and every row under it is one layer.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Ovl2Do: Click a layer under any section. The art you can put in it appears on the right.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Ovl3Do: Now click a card to wear it. Colour and strength sit above the cards, and Undo takes any of it back.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Ovl4: The makeup sections are different: that art is painted into the face itself, and only your own character has it. The game can wear fifteen layers at most, and the count above the sections keeps score.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Presets1: Most of these are outfit sets found in the armour mods you already have installed. It is a fast way to look through your gear without hunting the pieces down one slot at a time.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Presets2: The tabs above the list are where they came from: found in your mods, shipped in the Presets folder, or exported by you.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Presets3Do: Click any preset to try it on. Looking costs nothing and saves nothing.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Presets4: Save copies a preset into your own outfits, and your own exports are here too, under Exported. It can refuse, and it says why: your list may be full, or your settings may require you to own every piece first.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules1: A rule dresses you when something changes. Each card reads as one sentence: WHEN something is true, THEN wear this. The checkbox at the top turns them all on and off.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules2Do: Press + New Rule. The starters below make one that is already filled in.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules3Do: Press + Condition on your card and pick what has to be true.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules4Do: Now press + Effect and choose what the rule should put on you.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules5: Every card says Off, Active or Waiting. Active means the rule matches right now. Waiting means it is switched on and just not matching yet, which is where most rules sit most of the time.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Rules6: Order is priority. New rules arrive at the top and you can drag a card to move it. The bin on a card removes that rule, including the one you just made.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Shape1: These sliders belong to the character rather than to an outfit. They stay the same whatever this character wears.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Shape2: Body sliders sit under the category folds, with a search box above them. Proportions is a second fold further down.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Shape3: Dragging a slider is only a preview. The bar along the bottom is where you undo, discard or save, and leaving the page puts the character back.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Shape3Do: Try dragging one. Nothing is kept unless you save.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Welcome1: Welcome to Fitting Room; an interface to fit your character and followers however you like! Would you like a tutorial?
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Welcome2: The icons down the left edge move you between pages. Hover one to see what it is.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_Tut_Welcome2Do: The icons down the left edge are the pages. Click Outfits to start.
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_TypeTip: Show only Light, Heavy or Clothing pieces
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_WNotEquippedTip: Fitting Room restyles the weapon the game itself has drawn, so this one needs equipping first. A spare weapon shown on the back or hip by a display mod such as Immersive Equipment Displays belongs to that mod, and cannot be restyled from here
line:menu_translation/fitting-room:inter.$FR_WeaponHandTip: Both is the fallback style. Right and Left can use different styles or the real weapon
